g.text: Programming: Serial1 USB disconnected; programmer powers J4 pin1 at regulated 3.3 V.

g.desc: Programming: Serial1 USB disconnected; programmer powers J4 pin1 at regulated 3.3 V.

g.text: Normal use: disconnect the programmer completely, then connect Serial1 USB.

g.desc: Normal use: disconnect the programmer completely, then connect Serial1 USB.

g.text: U3 OUT and J4 pin1 share +3V3 directly; no reverse-current isolation.

g.desc: U3 OUT and J4 pin1 share +3V3 directly; no reverse-current isolation.

g.text: Adapter TX -> RXD0, RX <- TXD0; common GND; 3.3 V logic only.

g.desc: Adapter TX -> RXD0, RX <- TXD0; common GND; 3.3 V logic only.

g.text: EXTERNAL ESP32 UART0 PROGRAMMING / 3.3 V LOGIC ONLY

g.desc: EXTERNAL ESP32 UART0 PROGRAMMING / 3.3 V LOGIC ONLY

g.text: Keep this ceramic-stable regulator with MLCC output capacitor C5.

g.desc: Keep this ceramic-stable regulator with MLCC output capacitor C5.

g.text: C5: 22uF 25V X5R Basic; account for DC-bias derating.

g.desc: C5: 22uF 25V X5R Basic; account for DC-bias derating.

g.text: Manual download via J4: connect pin6 (GPIO0) to pin2 (GND).

g.desc: Manual download via J4: connect pin6 (GPIO0) to pin2 (GND).

g.text: Briefly connect pin5 (EN) to GND, then release EN with GPIO0 still low.

g.desc: Briefly connect pin5 (EN) to GND, then release EN with GPIO0 still low.

g.text: Flash via UART0; release GPIO0 and pulse EN again for normal boot.

g.desc: Flash via UART0; release GPIO0 and pulse EN again for normal boot.

g.text: R5/R6 pull-ups and C6 (1uF EN-to-GND) provide bias and reset timing.

g.desc: R5/R6 pull-ups and C6 (1uF EN-to-GND) provide bias and reset timing.
